concept:
« PAS LE JUNGLE. » A 79.8 s retention-first promo cut to the fixed 150 BPM track. It opens on the blame sentence from title #1, then turns it back on the viewer within 3 s (« …VRAIMENT ? », then « TOI : 0/4 À 8 MIN. »). The pain then becomes a vicious LOOP RING, JOUE · PERDS · OUBLIE. On the build-1 downbeats its nodes flip into the official signature JOUE · ANALYSE · RECOMMENCE, and a 5-4-3-2-1 countdown follows (the « 5 » is the 5 of NXT5). DROP 1 is the proof: logo splash, a dissected game, the debrief tied to its game, then a 10-pick draft locked one pick per beat. The breakdown slows to Persona jazz-funk for team life (roster, planning, 5/5 available, the Discord bot). The stripped bars hold a mid-video re-hook: « Tu débriefes vraiment tes scrims ? ». BUILD 2 swallows the excuses into an orb, answers with « PRÊTS ? », then gives a silent beat. DROP 2 answers « GO. » and moves from chaos (screens, spreadsheets, lost DMs) to one team space, the Importer, and four feature panels with subs. The stutter carries the CTA funnel: « Gratuit en ce moment. », then « Essaie la démo. », then « Crée ton espace. », then the callback « Arrête d'accuser le jungle. ». The outro rebuilds the logo from shards under a giant « ANALYSE. », which slides into the end card: logo, « Joue. Analyse. Recommence. », nxt5.org, and the action line « Essaie la démo · Crée ton espace ».

OPEN LOOPS AND PAYOFFS
- « Scrim perdu. Aucun débrief. » at 4.8 s is answered by the stamp « Scrim perdu ? Débrief. » at 24 s.
- « Même erreur demain. » at 6.4 s is answered at 60.8 s, after a 0.5-beat ghost of the old line is slashed: « Même erreur ? Notée. Suivie. ».
- « Et si tu savais pourquoi ? » at 12.8 s is answered by the logo and « Comprends tes parties. » at 19.2 s.
- « Tu débriefes vraiment tes scrims ? » at 41.6 s is answered by the teammate bubble 'go 21h' and the clipboard filling.
- JGL TOKEN running gag. A violet hexagon labelled 'JGL' is blamed with '?' pings in S01 and S02. It is the last fragment the orb swallows in S08. Its pings are zapped into cyan sparks in S11. In S12 it gets a gold ring and a 'gg' bubble.
- LOOP RING. It is fuchsia (vicious) in S01–S02, flips to spectrum in S03, and returns as a faint spectrum ring behind the end-card logo.

TRUTH GUARDRAILS
- Mock UIs show no numbers, no names and no invented stats.
- There is no radar chart and no 'top suggestion' crown; pick help filters and never ranks.
- The assistant is only shown helping people use NXT5.
- The Importer reads games from the local LoL client on Windows/Mac and produces a file that is imported into Parties.
- Free access is always written « Gratuit en ce moment » / « Aucun abonnement », with no price.
- The end card carries 'NXT5 n'est pas affilié à Riot Games.'
- No Riot art, emblems or Victory-screen lookalikes, no Discord, OS or Google/Apple logos, and no 'hextech' wording on screen. Every glyph, map, crest and silhouette is original canvas geometry.

PALETTE
- Night #070B17 and bg #111827, surface #1e293b, text #f1f5f9, text2 #cbd5e1.
- Cyan #67e8f9 / #22d3ee, blue #3b82f6, indigo #818cf8, violet #a78bfa / #c4b5fd, fuchsia #e879f9 / #d946ef.
- Spectrum gradient: K.linearSpectrum, or #22d3ee→#3b82f6→#d946ef.
- NO #ff3b5c red anywhere. Blame, stamps and strike-throughs use fuchsia #d946ef; small error accents use danger #fda4af.
- Gold #F5C66B appears only as a tiny accent: the S08 orb ring and the S12 JGL redemption ring.
- Session colours: Scrim fuchsia, Match cyan, Débrief violet.

FONTS
- Anton: slam and giant cards.
- Bebas Neue: stamps and map labels.
- Russo One: UI labels, counters and nxt5.org.
- Inter Display 900: calm cards. Inter 700: subs.

FRENCH TYPOGRAPHY
- Use the typographic apostrophe ’ (U+2019).
- Put a no-break space U+00A0 before ? ! : and inside « ».
- This keeps '?' glued to its word and keeps the strings matching their emph.

KIT CHANGES REQUIRED (small, do them first)
1. renderCards: the stamp colour becomes c.color || C.fuchsia2 (it is hardcoded to C.red at kit.mjs:880).
2. renderCards: accept an opts.emphColor and pass it to text/slam.
3. render.mjs: remove the global 1.4 s fade-out, or let the last scene return fx.noFadeOut, so the end card holds to 79.8 s. Fallback if this is not done: the lock-up is fully legible 74.4→78.4 s, which is 4 s, still at least 3 s.
4. Optional: in music.py, skip the bar-11 beat-3 snares as is done in bar 31. The S03 timing below is written for the CURRENT events, where snares still sound at 11.3.0, 11.3.125, 11.3.25 and 11.3.375.

CARD RULES (all scenes)
- Every scene calls K.renderCards with opts {subSize:54, size:150, maxW:1500 unless stated}. Subs are 54 px or larger.
- PLACEMENT RULE:
  - CENTRE (960,540) when a card stands alone.
  - LOWER THIRD (card y=870, sub pill bottom ≤1026) when UI fills the frame. All UI then stays above y=720.
  - LEFT COLUMN (x=470, maxW 760) in S06 and S07.
- A card with a sub is always at least 4 beats long. 2-beat cards have no sub.
- No 'stack' style is used anywhere, which avoids the stack-sub overlap and emph-token bugs.
- No card text equals 'NXT5'. The logo is always drawn with K.logo.
- Cards marked 'scene-drawn' are filtered out of renderCards and drawn by the scene with the kit primitives as described.

FX BUDGET
- The renderer already adds, on every impact, 26 px shake + 22 px RGB split + a 0.55 flash, and during drops it adds 8 px of shake per kick and 7 px RGB per snare.
- Scenes add NO extra kick shake in drops (scene shake 0–3 px). Total shake stays ≤10 px while a sub is on screen.
- Return fx {auto:false} with soft custom values at:
  - the bar-20 breakdown entry
  - the stutter bars 40–41
  - the 46.2 end-card hit
- Full-frame luminance or colour swaps happen at most 3 per second. The stutter changes bands, poses and angles over a constant dark field. There are no inversions and no slice strobes.
- Snare-roll strobes are thin outlines only.

EVENTS NOT IN music.events.json, which the scenes compute with K.barT:
- heartbeat sub on beats 1 and 1.75 of bars 0–7
- the 16th arp from bar 4
- crashes at 16, 24, 28, 36 and 40
- the octave lead in bars 32–39
- the brass stab at bar 4 beat 0 (it is in the events; bar 6 beat 0 is too)
Hats are 8ths in bars 4–7 and 26–27, and 16ths in the drops and in bars 20–25. There are no kicks before bar 6.

ALWAYS-ON LAYERS
- K.background plus 3-layer K.particles. The renderer adds the vignette, grain and scanlines; do not double them.
- A BRAND BUG: K.logo at (1772,62), width 150, alpha 0.55, gentle glow.
  - Visible from the bar-4 impact (6.4 s) to bar 44.
  - Hidden during the two silence frames (11.3.5–12.0 and 31.3–32.0) and in S12, where the big logo takes over.
- Every scene must draw a clean initial state when f.lt < 0, because transitions call the next scene up to 0.4 s early.
- Thumbnail still: 2.4 s (stamp « …VRAIMENT ? » over the ghost hook).

scenes.name: Le procès du jungle (hook)
scenes.visual:
BASE
- K.background night #070B17, 3-layer K.particles drifting slowly upward.
- TEXT BUDGET: one card + at most one sub on screen. No chat lines, scoreboard, timer or vote bar.

LOOP RING (the film's spine) at (960,560)
- 3 concentric rings: r=360/290/220, 2px fuchsia #d946ef stroke at 35% alpha, plus a 1px cyan #67e8f9 inner hairline at 15%.
- Tick marks: 60/36/24 ticks, 8–14px long.
- Draw-on by arc length (easeInOutCubic): outer ring over bar 0, middle ring over bar 1, inner ring over bars 2–3.
- Rotation: +3°/s, −5°/s, +8°/s. No labels yet.

FRAME 0 = IMPACT
- Card 1 is scene-drawn with K.slamText starting at p=0.6, so it is already legible on frame 0. It settles to scale 1 by 0.1s.
- Text: Anton ~170px white, 'JUNGLE' in spectrum, centred at y=560.
- Backing: a jagged black 'chat shard', an irregular 7-point polygon ~1500×260, #0b0f1e fill, 4px fuchsia #d946ef edge, rotated −4°.
- K.shockwave at (960,560): cyan, r 0→1400 over 1 beat, 12 spark lines. The renderer's auto impact FX apply.

GLITCH (bar 0 b3 → bar 1 b1)
- RGB-split ramp on the hook: cyan/fuchsia copies offset 0→14px, 6 horizontal slices displaced ±40px.

STAMP (bar 1 b1)
- '…VRAIMENT ?' in FUCHSIA #d946ef (not kit red), −8°, scale 2.2→1, 14 ink droplets plus a small halftone splash.
- Behind it the hook remains as a 25% desaturated ghost. A 6px fuchsia strike line draws across the ghost left→right in 0.25 beat.

BAR 2 (choir)
- A violet god-ray descends behind the ring: a 500px-wide vertical gradient, #a78bfa 0→18%, fading in over 1 bar.
- JGL TOKEN appears on the top of the middle ring at (960,240):
  - pointy-top hexagon r=46, fill #1e1b4b, 3px violet #a78bfa outline
  - label 'JGL' in Russo One 24px #c4b5fd
  - rises from y=300 with easeOutBack over 0.5 beat
- On each heartbeat of bars 2–3 (4 in total), a fuchsia '?' ping flies into the token:
  - ping = circle r=34 + Anton '?' at 40px, 4-frame RGB split
  - spawns at a screen edge and flies in over 0.3s (easeInCubic)
  - each ping adds one stacked blame ring around the token (r 60/72/84/96, 2px fuchsia)
- Card 3 is jagged at the centre, y=600.

BAR 3
- The background dims 15%.
- The token cracks: 3 white 2px crack polylines, one each on b1, b1.75 and b2.
- Card 4 slams at the centre, y=600.
scenes.sync:
HEARTBEAT (computed at K.barT(bar,1) and K.barT(bar,1.75); not in the events)
- Ring scale 1→1.035→1 over 0.15s.
- Ring alpha +40%.
- Vignette-style dark radial breath.
- Scene fx.shake 3px.

0.0 IMPACT
- Hook slam, shockwave, auto shake and flash.

RING DRAW-ON
- Each ring finishes on a downbeat: bars 1, 2 and 4.

0.3 → 1.1
- The glitch ramps.

1.1 (2.0s, heartbeat)
- The stamp lands, with scene fx.shake 10 and fx.rgb 8 for 0.15s.

2.0 (choir entry)
- God-ray in, token rises.
- Jagged card: letters pop over 1.2 beats.
- Ping 1 at 2.1, ping 2 at 2.1.75.

3.0
- Slam card 4.
- Ping 3 at 3.1, ping 4 at 3.1.75.
- The token cracks on 3.1, 3.1.75 and 3.2.

3.3.5
- The renderer's slash launches (pre 0.5 beat) and covers the frame on the bar-4 impact + brass stab.

scenes.name: La boucle perdante
scenes.visual:
CARD ANCHOR
- Top third: card y=190, maxW 1400, sub pill under it at ~y 285. The board stays below y=360.

ISO BOARD (original schematic, no Riot map art)
- A diamond with vertices T(960,380), R(1540,670), B(960,960), L(380,670).
- Fill #0b1224, 1px #1e293b grid of 12×12 iso cells, 30% cyan edge glow.
- Ally base: cyan hexagon r=34 at B. Enemy base: fuchsia hexagon r=34 at T.
- Lanes are 8px polylines, slate #334155 until lit:
  - top: B→L→T
  - mid: B→T
  - bot: B→R→T
- Lit lanes turn cyan #22d3ee with an 18px glow. Highlight dashes travel along them, lineDashOffset stepped on every 16th of the arp.
- River: a soft bezier from L to R, 26px wide, blue #3b82f6 at 40%, with shimmering dashes.
- The JGL token (r=30 here) patrols the river on a sine path.

FORESHADOW PANEL
- An ignored dim panel at x1480–1840, y760–960: K.panel, #1e293b at 60%, 1px cyan border at 20%.
- It holds a slow pulsing cyan sparkline: the facts, waiting.

BAR 4
- The board punches in, scale 1.2→1 (easeOutExpo).
- Lanes ignite top, mid, bot on b0, b1, b2.
- 'Same mistake' marks on mid lane at 60%:
  - a fuchsia X (two 10px bars, 48px) stamps on b0
  - an RGB-split ghost X lands on the exact same spot on b2
  - a third on b3
- A circular loop arrow (270° arc r=60 + triangle head, 3px fuchsia) spins around the X marks once per bar.

BAR 5
- Enemy pings (fuchsia circle + Russo '!' + expanding ring 0→80px, 6px RGB split) pop on the 8th hats, one per hat, max 8, scattered on the lanes.
- Each pop also sends a small '?' to the JGL token.

BAR 6 (brass, kicks every beat)
- The board tilts: y-scale ×0.85, rotation +3° (easeInOutCubic over 1 bar).
- On each kick, one cluster of 2 pings freezes, desaturates to slate #64748b and turns into small cyan squares (8px).
- The squares fly on arcs into the foreshadow panel and build an 8×4 data grid there: chaos becoming data.

BAR 7
- At 7.0 the board flips away (scaleY 1→0, easeInExpo, 0.25 beat).
- The LOOP RING returns at (960,640), r=230, fuchsia #d946ef, 4px stroke, with 3 arrowheads along it.
- 3 nodes at −90°/30°/150°: small filled circles r=14 with labels JOUE / PERDS / OUBLIE in Bebas Neue 52px #e879f9.
- The foreshadow panel stays lit bottom-right, glowing cyan.
scenes.sync:
4.0 IMPACT + BRASS STAB
- Slash lands, board punch, top lane ignites, X mark 1. Auto impact FX.

16th ARP (computed)
- Lane dashes step.

8th HATS
- Grid dots twinkle; bar-5 pings spawn.

HEARTBEATS (b1, b1.75)
- Both base hexes pulse 1→1.15.

4.2 / 4.3
- Ghost X marks.

5.0
- Jagged card.

6.0 BRASS STAB
- Tilt starts; slam card with sub.

KICKS 6.0–6.3
- One ping cluster → data squares per kick.
- Board plate punches down 6px; scene shake 4px; energy is below 0.9, so no auto kick shake.

7.0–7.3 KICKS
- The loop ring steps +30° per kick (easeOutExpo, 0.15s each).
- The node labels pulse.

7.3.5
- Zoom transition (pre 0.5 beat) dives into the ring centre.

scenes.name: La boucle se retourne (build 1)
scenes.visual:
LOOP RING at (960,440)
- r=250, nodes JOUE / PERDS / OUBLIE.
- Fuchsia 4px stroke at the start, with a slow push-in (scale 1→1.2 over 4 bars, easeInCubic).
- Rotation doubles each bar: 20, 40, 80, 160 °/s.

SPEED LINES (K.speedLines)
- Radial streaks from the centre: 2px, white or cyan, 200–700px long, alpha 0.6, decaying over 0.15s.
- One burst per snare hit, so density follows the roll.

RISER
- The background lifts from #070B17 to #1e1b4b at the centre.
- Particles reverse into an accelerating inward vacuum.
- A cyan horizon hairline at y=540 grows 0→1920px wide and 1→4px thick.
- Halftone (K.halftone, −18°, two bands, alpha 0.06) flashes on each snare.

CARD PLACEMENT
- Bar 8 card: lower third, y=870.
- Giant word cards: centre, y=560. The ring dims to 35% while a giant word is on.

NODE FLIPS (scaleX 1→0→1 over 0.25 beat, plus K.shockwave r 0→120 at the node)

COUNTDOWN (10.2 → 11.2), scene-drawn

- Each digit sits on its own −18° diagonal split. The upper-left half is tinted at 35% alpha, never full brightness: violet for 5, cyan for 4, indigo for 3, fuchsia for 2, blue for 1.

- The ring stays visible behind at 30%.

SILENCE AND FREEZE (timing follows the current music data)
- The last 4 snares (11.3.0 / .125 / .25 / .375) each draw one white 3px crack segment radiating from the ring centre through the '1'.
- From 11.3.5 (19.0s), HARD FREEZE:

  - the frame desaturates 40%
  - no audio-reactive motion
- The '1' stays frozen on screen; it is scene-drawn with no exit fade.

KICKS
